item.title: National Ambulance Service To Consider Mapping Clare Defibrillators
item.description: The National Ambulance Service says it will consider a proposal to map Clare’s defibrillators on Google Maps. item.title: Record Number Of Top Building Energy Ratings Awarded In Clare Last Year
item.description: A record number of A1 Building Energy Rating certificates were awarded to homes in Clare last year.
